qns_content.text: Which of the following is a tertiary alkyl halide?

text_solutions: A tertiary alkyl halide has the halogen attached to a carbon bonded to three other carbons. \( \ce{(CH3)3CBr} \) (2-bromo-2-methylpropane) is tertiary.

qns_content.text: How many monochloro isomers are formed by free radical chlorination of \( \ce{CH3CH2CH3} \)?

text_solutions: Propane has two types of hydrogens: 6 primary (on terminal carbons) and 2 secondary (on the middle carbon). Chlorination gives \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Cl} \) and \( \ce{CH3CHClCH3} \), so 2 isomers.

qns_content.text: What is the hybridization of the carbon attached to bromine in \( \ce{CH2=CHCH2Br} \)?

text_solutions: In \( \ce{CH2=CHCH2Br} \), the carbon attached to Br has four single bonds (to Br, H, H, and \( \ce{CH=CH2} \)), making it sp³ hybridized.

qns_content.text: What is the order of reactivity of alkyl halides towards \( \ce{S_N1} \) mechanism?

text_solutions: \( \ce{S_N1} \) reactivity depends on carbocation stability: tertiary > secondary > primary.

qns_content.text: Which reagent is preferred for converting a primary alcohol to an alkyl chloride with gaseous byproducts?

text_solutions: Thionyl chloride (\( \ce{SOCl2} \)) reacts with alcohols to form alkyl chlorides, producing \( \ce{SO2} \) and \( \ce{HCl} \), both gases, making it preferred for pure product formation.

qns_content.text: Which halide reacts with \( \ce{Mg} \) in dry ether to form a reagent that produces \( \ce{CH3CH2CH3} \) on hydrolysis?

text_solutions: \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Br} \) forms \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2MgBr} \) with \( \ce{Mg} \), which hydrolyzes with \( \ce{H2O} \) to \( \ce{CH3CH2CH3} \) (propane).

qns_content.text: What is the product when benzene reacts with \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Cl} \) and \( \ce{AlCl3} \)?

text_solutions: Friedel-Crafts alkylation of benzene with \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Cl} \) and \( \ce{AlCl3} \) forms \( \ce{C6H5CH2CH2CH3} \) (propylbenzene).

qns_content.text: What is the product when \( \ce{CH3CH=CH2} \) reacts with \( \ce{HBr} \) in the presence of \( \ce{C6H5COOOH} \)?

text_solutions: With peroxide (\( \ce{C6H5COOOH} \)), \( \ce{HBr} \) adds to propene anti-Markovnikov, forming \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Br} \) (1-bromopropane).

text_solutions: Free radical bromination of butane (\( \ce{CH3CH2CH2CH3} \)) with \( \ce{Br2} \) in light forms \( \ce{CH3CH2CHBrCH3} \) (2-bromobutane) as one product.

qns_content.text: What is the major product when \( \ce{CH3CH2CH=CH2} \) reacts with \( \ce{HI} \) in the absence of peroxides?

text_solutions: For 1-butene (\( \ce{CH3CH2CH=CH2} \)), \( \ce{HI} \) adds via Markovnikov’s rule, forming \( \ce{CH3CH2CHICH3} \) (2-iodobutane).

qns_content.text: How many monochloro isomers are possible for \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2CH2CH3} \)?

text_solutions: Pentane (\( \ce{CH3CH2CH2CH2CH3} \)) has three unique carbon positions for Cl substitution (C1/C5, C2/C4, C3), yielding 3 isomers.

qns_content.text: What is the precipitate formed when \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Br} \) reacts with \( \ce{AgNO3} \) in ethanol?

text_solutions: \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2Br} \) reacts via \( \ce{S_N1} \) with \( \ce{AgNO3} \), forming \( \ce{AgBr} \) (yellow precipitate) and \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2ONO2} \).

qns_content.text: Which of the following is prepared by free radical halogenation of an alkane?

text_solutions: Free radical halogenation of propane (\( \ce{CH3CH2CH3} \)) with \( \ce{Cl2} \) forms \( \ce{CH3CHClCH3} \) (2-chloropropane) as one product.

qns_content.text: Which nucleophile converts \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2I} \) to \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2OC(CH3)3} \) in a polar aprotic solvent?

text_solutions: \( \ce{NaOC(CH3)3} \) (sodium tert-butoxide) substitutes I in \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2I} \) via \( \ce{S_N2} \) to form \( \ce{CH3CH2CH2OC(CH3)3} \).

qns_content.text: What is the hybridization of the carbon attached to iodine in \( \ce{CH3CH=CHI} \)?

text_solutions: In \( \ce{CH3CH=CHI} \), the carbon with I is part of a double bond (C=C), making it sp² hybridized.

text_solutions: A vinylic halide has the halogen directly attached to a carbon in a C=C bond. \( \ce{CH2=CHCl} \) (vinyl chloride) is a vinylic halide.

qns_content.text: Which of the following is a geminal dihalide?

text_solutions: A geminal dihalide has two halogens on the same carbon. \( \ce{CH3CH2CCl2CH3} \) (2,2-dichlorobutane) is geminal.

qns_content.text: Which of the following is a secondary halide?

text_solutions: A secondary halide has the halogen on a carbon bonded to two other carbons. \( \ce{CH3CH2CHBrCH3} \) (3-bromobutane) is secondary.
